subject: Quick note on Wyvern Sheet Metal's website
bodyText:
Hi,

I'm Mani from Rogue.

We look for solid businesses that still look stuck online - and Wyvern Sheet Metal stood out.

Worcester sheet metal and fabrications on the Blackpole Trading Estate - and wyvernsheetmetal.co.uk still pulls html5.js from html5shiv.googlecode.com/svn/trunk, keeps Copyright 2013 in the footer, and still publishes Fax: 01905 753599 beside the main telephone line. Serious Midlands fabricator; a front end still depending on a long-retired Google Code repo.

If useful, I'll send a short 3-point teardown over email - what's dated, what's costing you, and the first fix. No call required.

Reply YES and I'll send it.
